LOOK: Nine government employees of Bayawan City, Negros Oriental, were killed after a dump truck they were riding fell off a cliff and landed into a river in Barangay Kalamtukan, Bayawan City on Wednesday, Feb. 4. 

Police Capt. Stephen Polinar, spokesperson of Negros Oriental police, said that nobody survived the accident. 

Based on initial investigation, the vehicle was carrying five containers of crude oil, when the accident happened in a far-flung area at 11:10 a.m. | via Glazyl Masculino

📷: Negros Oriental Police Provincial Office
